purpose: Native architecture-only vertical masonry for Emberfall 0.47. Horizontal caps retain Rock030; floor and character materials are separate.
origin: ambientCG external CC0 material; not original Emberfall texture and not generated imagery.
download_request_notes: The official get link redirected to the listed public CDN. First generic request returned HTTP 403; a normal request with the official source page as Referer succeeded with HTTP 200. No credentials or access bypass used.

inspection.observations: Weathered dark gray/olive natural rubble/rough ashlar masonry, irregular approximately horizontal courses, broad mortar joints and mineral wear; no red brick. Source is warm/olive, so the mapping proposal reduces chroma in shader while preserving luminance contrast.
inspection.limitations: Native runtime confirmation and independent review are recorded in docs/previews/visible-combat and docs/design/graphics-review-047.md. Source 1K maps are 1024x512; no measured physical scale or sculpted displacement is claimed.

runtime_integration: scripts/ruin_architecture.gd; assets/shaders/masonry_surface.gdshader. One cached material per live world, world-aligned 2.8 by 1.4 m repeat, regional tint, relief disabled in Battery mode.
